items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025

ctx.x: Okay. Joe Ford is another one. He and I had our very first gigs together and he was playing saxophone then. It was a trio. It was saxophone, piano, and conga. And the conga player, his name was Reggie McQuella. He was the leader of the band. He organized this whole thing. And it was at the YMCA and it was a dance. And people were actually dancing you know. I think we made about 10 or 12 dollars apiece on that gig. Yeah.
That’s a lot of pressure on the piano player with no bass and, you know, carrying the rhythm.
